title: Mallworld is not a psychic realm you visit when you sleep.

classification.theory_summary: Argues Mallworld dreams are a common dream style produced by brain information-processing during sleep; not a psychic/shared realm; encourages skepticism.
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream episode described; only general references to common dream motifs and that the author has vivid recurring Mallworld dreams.

meta.author_theory: Mallworld is not a psychic realm; it is a common style of dream like flying/slow-running/teeth-falling-out dreams; author reports having vivid Mallworld dreams their entire life and revisiting the same places.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no concrete scene/setting descriptions. Only general phenomenological claims: 'Mallworld' dreams are vivid; author 'often revisit[s] the same places over and over'; author has had them 'my entire life'/'since childhood' and calls them 'wandering dreams'. Mentions generic dream motifs (flying; running slowly while escaping a monster; teeth falling out) and a hypothetical 'angry mob waiting for me in my dreams tonight' but without a described episode.
